title: Make Art & Make Money: Financial Planning for Creatives, with AJ Ayers | Money Moves
summary: We've got a special guest, gang! AJ Ayers, author of "Creative Money: New Financial Rules for Artists, Innovators, and Misfits," joins Jill and Mark to share practical money advice for anyone who feels the financial system wasn't built for them. You won't want to miss this episode — or AJ's book!
